description: Dataset for "Enhancing Bad Data Identification in Power System State Estimation Utilizing a Novel MILP Formulation is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Saeed Sheikhi Shoorestani, Ahmad Salehi Dobakhshari. This dataset contains the simulation results and measurement data obtained from the IEEE 118-bus test system, which support the findings of the paper titled “Enhancing Bad Data Identification in Power System State Estimation Utilizing a Novel MILP Formulation.”. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
